quests.title: Down Cooper's Hill
quests.summary: Win the creature version of the Cooper's Hill cheese-rolling: chase a Double Gloucester down a hill too steep to stand on.

steps.text: Learn the rules from the cheesemaker at Cooper's Hill Dairy, at the bottom of the hill.
Catch a Gloucelet in the tall grass and show it to the cheesemaker.
Win the race: three chasers, back to back, down Cooper's Hill.

quests.reward: Three Double Gloucester, the Cooper's Hill Ribbon (a Brawn charm) and standing in England.

quests.title: You Can't Count Them Twice
quests.summary: The Rollright Stones can never be counted the same twice. Count them from three sides and see.

steps.text: Ask the counter on the north side of the King's Men how many stones there are.
Ask the counter on the east side.
Ask the counter on the west side.
Tell the Stone Keeper what you found.

quests.reward: The Rollright Pebble (a Ward charm), two Banbury Cakes and standing in England.
